Slop AI Tools

Text from images and PDFs. Read on your device, nothing uploaded.

All pages are included, in order. The Word file starts each page on a new page.

Languages, the model and the PDF text layer

Languages. The model reads Simplified Chinese and English, digits and punctuation, and these accented letters: é è à á ä ì í ò ó ú ü, É Ë Ó Ü, and the pinyin letters ā ē ī ō ū ǐ ǒ. Letters outside that list, such as ñ, ç, ö, ß, â or ù, are not in its dictionary and come out wrong or missing. The Chinese part of the dictionary has about 6,270 characters.

The model. PP-OCRv4 from Slop AI Tools. It is downloaded only when you press Get more and confirm its licence. Nothing downloads on its own, and without it this page reads nothing.

Searchable PDF. The picture of each page is kept, with an invisible text layer on top, so you can search and select the text. The standard PDF font draws Latin letters only, so the characters it cannot draw are left out of the text layer (the picture still shows them). Text is placed at each line's position; if you add or remove lines, the extra lines sit below the last box.

Accuracy. Read the text before you use it. Only horizontal lines are read; rotated text is not turned first.
